timeline.description: At 59, Uttar Pradesh resident Vijay Kumar Sharma has achieved his long-held dream of becoming a government teacher after 27 years of attempts. Sharma, who cleared TGT written examinations six times and PGT exams four times but missed final selection, has been appointed as a Sanskrit TGT at Ailum Inter College in Shamli.
